summary: Install ansible-builder on RHEL with a valid subscription and Podman: dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms ansible-builder (adjust for RHEL 10); the free Red Hat Ansible Developer subscription MCT4589 also works.
questions: How do I install ansible-builder on RHEL?
Which repo provides ansible-builder for AAP 2.6?
Can I install ansible-builder without a managed node subscription?

answer_card.title: Install Ansible Builder
answer_card.answer_md:
Needs an attached subscription and Podman.
```bash
sudo dnf install --enablerepo=ansible-automation-platform-2.6-for-rhel-9-x86_64-rpms ansible-builder
```
On RHEL 10, use the rhel-10 repo name. The free *Red Hat Ansible Developer* subscription (MCT4589) can be used for developer tools.
